text:
rachel: Heads-up — new hire hit a blocker on the Cloudflare Workers sample. Deploy fails with several runtime errors: `ReferenceError: process is not defined` and later `Error: Cannot find module 'fs'` even though we only call fetch + JWT verify. bundle shows a `buffer` import pulled in by jwt-decode helper. Anyone seen this?

sam: Yup. Classic bundler/node-polyfill leakage. Most JWT helpers import node builtins indirectly. Which bundler are you using in the sample app?

rachel: esbuild via wrangler, default config. No explicit polyfills.

toni: Two-prong fix: 1) change the dependency to a web-first JWT helper (or use direct WebCrypto verify), 2) scope a tiny edge shim package that exports explicit web-first functions and a small package.json conditional export map so node-only entrypoints aren't resolved in worker builds.

toni: Example package.json exports pattern we use in other libs: 
```json
{
  "name": "@redwood/inference-edge-utils",
  "exports": {
    "./crypto": {
      "worker": "dist/crypto.worker.mjs",
      "node": "dist/crypto.node.cjs",
      "default": "dist/crypto.mjs"
    }
  },
  "types": "dist/index.d.ts"
}
```
This prevents the bundler from pulling the node variant when target=worker (wrangler/esbuild respects conditional exports when configured).

sam: If your bundler still pulls node builtins, check if any dependency has a `browser` field override or a `module` entry that points at node-flavored code. esbuild sometimes auto-polyfills buffer/os if `process.env` is referenced. Recommend running `npm ls buffer` to trace.

rachel: Good tip. Also seeing crypto differences — Cloudflare has web crypto but does not support subtle.importKey for raw PKCS8 in some older stacks. Any recommended fallback?

toni: For verifiers we switched to explicit WebCrypto usage in the shim with a clear runtime check and a helpful error that links to docs. Example helper: 
```js
export async function verifyJwt(webKey, sig, payload){
  if (typeof globalThis.crypto?.subtle?.importKey !== 'function'){
    throw new Error('WebCrypto importKey not available in this runtime. See https://go.redwood.dev/edge-crypto')
  }
  const key = await crypto.subtle.importKey('spki', webKey, {name: 'RSA-PSS'}, false, ['verify'])
  return crypto.subtle.verify({name: 'RSA-PSS', saltLength: 32}, key, sig, payload)
}
```
We ship that in the edge-only entry so Node users still get a Node-optimized path.

sam: Typing gotcha: TS projects hit errors when you add a shim file without a d.ts. Make sure the shim package includes `types` and a minimal index.d.ts exporting the functions. Also include a README snippet for tsconfig: {"lib": ["es2021","webworker"], "moduleResolution": "bundler"}.

rachel: CI around this is messy — our integration matrix ran worker tests in plain node and failed due to webcrypto differences.

ci-bot: Created CI ticket: https://git.internal/redwood/issues/987 - add Miniflare job to test worker targets.

toni: For CI, add a miniflare step and mark node-only tests separately. Also ensure the npm package build includes both mjs and cjs artifacts. Wrapping the worker sample in a `--target=service-worker` esbuild config fixes a lot of automatic polyfills.

rachel: Should we publish a small official shim package rather than have each customer DIY? I can see this being a big onboarding friction.

toni: Yes — plan: publish `@redwood/inference-edge-shims` with: safeFetch (auth + retry), web-crypto helpers, explicit stubs for node builtins that throw with a clear link, and a tiny README checklist. Keep it opt-in and tiny. I'll draft the package, include d.ts, and add conditional exports.

sam: Also adding a devex lint rule: detect imports from known node-only modules (`fs`, `net`, `child_process`, `os`) when package.json or tsconfig indicates `target: edge` or `platform: 'worker'`. We can surface a UX-friendly message linking to the shim or recommended replacement.

rachel: Perfect. I'll update the sample app to use the shim and swap the JWT helper for web-first code. Once CI passes with miniflare we can add a short onboarding note in the samples README enumerating: 1) node builtins, 2) webcrypto caveats, 3) bundler target flags, 4) tsconfig tips.

devx-bot: Draft PR opened: https://github.com/redwood-inference/samples/pull/101 — adds shim and sample-worker fix. CI pending. :sparkles:
